subject: Operations
title: The 2011 Thailand Floods
description: A quick win: understand The 2011 Thailand Floods.

hook.text: Floods in Thailand shut down 25% of the world's hard drive production. Computer prices spiked globally for months.

buildup.text: Thailand had become a global hub for hard drive manufacturing. Major suppliers concentrated in flood-prone areas.

discovery.text: When monsoon floods hit in 2011, entire industrial parks were submerged. Production stopped for months.

twist.text: Companies with diverse suppliers recovered quickly. Those dependent on Thai factories suffered massive revenue losses.

climax.text: The floods cost the global economy $45 billion and accelerated the shift from hard drives to solid-state storage.

punchline.text: Concentration is efficient until disaster hits that one spot.
